groups.title: Data Structures
groups.blurb: How data is laid out, and what that makes cheap or expensive.

groups.title: Algorithms & Patterns
groups.blurb: Reusable moves for turning a slow idea into a fast one.

lessons.title: Arrays
lessons.oneLiner: A row of numbered boxes, side by side in memory.
lessons.trigger: You need instant access by position.
lessons.notThisWhen: You insert or delete in the middle a lot.

lessons.title: Dynamic Arrays
lessons.oneLiner: An array that grows by moving into a bigger home.
lessons.trigger: You need an array but don't know the final size.
lessons.notThisWhen: Every single append must be fast, never occasionally slow.

lessons.title: Strings
lessons.oneLiner: An array of characters with its own tricks.
lessons.trigger: The input is text: words, palindromes, anagrams, substrings.

lessons.title: Linked Lists
lessons.oneLiner: A chain of nodes, each holding the way to the next.
lessons.trigger: You rewire order often, or the problem hands you a ListNode.
lessons.notThisWhen: You need to jump straight to the k-th element.

lessons.title: Stacks
lessons.oneLiner: Last in, first out — a pile of plates.
lessons.trigger: Matching pairs, undo, or 'the most recent unresolved thing'.

lessons.title: Queues
lessons.oneLiner: First in, first out — a line at the counter.
lessons.trigger: Process things in the order they arrived, level by level.

lessons.title: Hash Maps & Sets
lessons.oneLiner: Turn a key into a bucket number and look there directly.
lessons.trigger: 'Have I seen this before?' or 'how many times?'.
lessons.notThisWhen: You need the keys in sorted order.

lessons.title: Binary Trees
lessons.oneLiner: Each node has up to two children; problems split in half.
lessons.trigger: Hierarchies, or the problem hands you a TreeNode.

lessons.title: Binary Search Trees
lessons.oneLiner: A tree where left is smaller and right is bigger, all the way down.
lessons.trigger: Sorted order that must stay sorted while you insert and delete.

lessons.title: Heaps & Priority Queues
lessons.oneLiner: Always hand me the smallest (or largest) next.
lessons.trigger: 'Top K', 'K-th largest', or repeatedly take the best option.

lessons.title: Graphs
lessons.oneLiner: Dots and lines: anything connected to anything.
lessons.trigger: Networks, maps, dependencies, or a grid you can walk.

lessons.title: Tries
lessons.oneLiner: A tree of letters where shared prefixes share a path.
lessons.trigger: Autocomplete, prefix search, or many words checked at once.

lessons.title: Two Pointers
lessons.oneLiner: Two fingers on the data, moving with purpose.
lessons.trigger: A sorted array and a pair or triple that must meet a target.
lessons.notThisWhen: The array is unsorted and order matters — try a hash map.

lessons.title: Sliding Window
lessons.oneLiner: A frame that slides along; you only update its edges.
lessons.trigger: 'Contiguous subarray / substring' with a size or a condition.
lessons.notThisWhen: The elements don't have to be next to each other.

lessons.title: Fast & Slow Pointers
lessons.oneLiner: A hare and a tortoise: if there's a loop, they meet.
lessons.trigger: Cycles, or the middle of a linked list in one pass.

lessons.title: Prefix Sum
lessons.oneLiner: Precompute running totals; any range sum is one subtraction.
lessons.trigger: Many range-sum questions, or 'subarray sums to k'.

lessons.title: Binary Search
lessons.oneLiner: Halve the search space with every question.
lessons.trigger: Sorted data, or 'find the smallest value that works'.

lessons.title: Sorting
lessons.oneLiner: Put things in order, then problems get easier.
lessons.trigger: Order would make pairs, duplicates or intervals obvious.

lessons.title: Searching
lessons.oneLiner: Choosing how to find something based on how it's stored.
lessons.trigger: 'Find X' — the right method depends on sorted, hashed or raw.

lessons.title: Recursion & Backtracking
lessons.oneLiner: Solve a smaller copy of the problem; undo choices that fail.
lessons.trigger: 'All combinations / subsets / permutations', or self-similar structure.

lessons.title: BFS & DFS
lessons.oneLiner: Explore ripple by ripple (BFS) or path by path (DFS).
lessons.trigger: Shortest steps in an unweighted graph, islands, or levels.

lessons.title: Greedy
lessons.oneLiner: Take the best-looking move now — when you can prove it's safe.
lessons.trigger: Intervals, scheduling, or 'minimum number of …' with a clear best pick.
lessons.notThisWhen: A locally good choice can trap you later — reach for DP.

lessons.title: Dynamic Programming
lessons.oneLiner: Remember answers to small problems; build the big one from them.
lessons.trigger: 'Number of ways', 'min/max cost', and choices that overlap.
